privacy.metaDescription: How TheOpenLearn collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use our service.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TheOpenLearn helps you turn learning materials into structured roadmaps. This policy describes how we handle personal information in connection with the website, application, and related features (the Service). By using the Service, you acknowledge this policy.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body:
Account and identity: If you sign in, authentication is provided by our identity provider (for example Clerk), which may process your email, name, profile image, and security-related data according to their own policies.

Learning content: You may submit URLs, text, files, or notes so we can generate learning plans, tasks, and related content. That material is processed to operate the Service.

Usage and diagnostics: We may collect technical and usage data such as device type, browser, approximate region, feature usage, and error logs to keep the Service reliable and secure.

Community features: If you opt in to community or visibility features, we may store preferences and aggregate or profile information you choose to display.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body:
We use information to provide, maintain, and improve the Service (including AI-assisted generation), personalize your experience, communicate with you about the product, enforce our terms, comply with law, and protect users and the platform.

We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: AI processing and providers
sections.body: To generate roadmaps and learning assistance, content you submit may be sent to third-party AI and infrastructure providers. Those transfers are limited to what is needed to fulfill your request and operate the Service. Providers are expected to process data under their agreements and applicable law. Do not submit highly sensitive personal data (such as medical records or government identifiers) unless you accept the associated risk.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: We and our vendors may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies for session management, preferences, security, and analytics. You can adjust browser settings to limit some technologies; parts of the Service may not work correctly if you do.

sections.title: Retention, security, and your choices
sections.body:
We retain information as long as needed to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. We apply reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect data; no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure.

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export certain personal data, or to object to or restrict certain processing. You can often exercise choices through your account or by contacting us. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.title: International transfers and changes
sections.body: We may process information in countries other than where you live. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards. We may update this policy from time to time; the updated date will appear at the top. Continued use after changes means you accept the revised policy to the extent permitted by law.

Meta.title: TheOpenLearn — AI learning with a real system
Meta.description: An LMS-style path with mind maps, a learning curve, and gamified progress—plus AI that helps you stay consistent and finish what you start.

hero.titleTrail: . But this time, with a system.
hero.subtitle: AI builds your roadmap, tracks your progress, and keeps you consistent—so you actually finish what you start.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Paste a URL, upload a PDF (structure ready), or write raw text — plus a short note on what “done” means for you.
how.step2Body: We summarize subject, scope, difficulty, language, and depth. You edit and approve before anything is generated.
how.step3Body: Phases unlock in order. Each lesson has resources, a self-check, XP, achievements, and an AI guide that stays scoped to that lesson. After you complete a lesson, you can unlock an AI-written handbook PDF and keep it in your library for spaced review.

structured.title: Structured by design
structured.body: Phases, tasks, references, and checkpoints keep big topics approachable.

ai.title: Thoughtful AI
ai.body: No surprise wall of tasks — we align on intent first, then generate.

progress.title: Visible momentum
progress.body: Progress, streaks, and a clear coin balance — you always see what you have finished and what is next.

handbooks.title: Handbooks you keep
handbooks.body: Turn a finished lesson into a polished PDF reference — summaries, pitfalls, and quick-review bullets. Everything lands in your handbooks library for easy download anytime.

rewards.title: How your coins work
rewards.subtitle: Each new roadmap costs a few coins so you only start a journey when you mean it. You earn them back as you finish topics and full roadmaps—the same stretch where your knowledge deepens—with steady grants and invites so you are never stuck.
rewards.extrasTitle: A few more things worth knowing
rewards.extrasHint: Helpful context — not the headline of the product.

starter.title: Starter balance
starter.body: You start with 50 coins — enough to spin up several roadmaps and feel the loop before you need to earn more.

spend.title: Start a journey
spend.body: Each new roadmap costs 10 coins — it keeps generation deliberate and matches real focus time.

earn.title: Grow knowledge, refill your balance
earn.body: Every completed task is real progress in your head, not just a checkbox. Finishing every task in a topic pays 10 coins; completing the entire roadmap pays 25 (including a one-time completion bonus). Substantial reflection notes when you finish a task can add 5 more.

monthly.title: Monthly grant
monthly.body: Every calendar month, you get +30 coins automatically — a fresh allowance without streak pressure.

referrals.title: Invite friends
referrals.body: Share your code from the dashboard. When someone applies it, you get +30 coins — they still get the full product experience.

moments.title: Milestones that feel real
moments.body: Completing a task, a topic, or the whole roadmap gives you a clear read on what you unlocked and what comes next — not a vague “done” with no context.

handbooks.title: PDF handbooks (optional)
handbooks.body: After you pass a lesson’s self-check, you can spend a small one-time coin amount to generate a handbook PDF from that lesson’s content — yours to download again from your library.

gamification.title: Motivation without the noise
gamification.body: Earn XP, collect badges like First Step and Roadmap Finisher, stack coins when you close phases, chat with a lesson-scoped AI coach, and build a shelf of handbook PDFs — steady motivation without gimmicks.
gamification.panel: XP reflects depth, badges reflect habits. Every major step — a task, a topic, or the full journey — comes with explicit recognition and a clear next move. The AI coach answers in the context of each open lesson; handbooks crystallize what you learned into something you can reopen from your library. Steady coin grants keep the loop rewarding.

i18n.title: Speak your language
i18n.body: TheOpenLearn ships in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Serbian, and Turkish — with more locales easy to add. Your UI and roadmap language setting stays with you.

cta.title: Ready for a calmer way to learn?
cta.body: Create an account, claim your starter coins, and generate your first journey in minutes. Every lesson you finish can grow your personal PDF library when you want a keepsake reference.

howTo.phase_crusher: Pick one journey and finish every task in a single phase. Work through that phase until each lesson is marked complete.
howTo.consistent_learner: Finish five separate lessons in total. They can be in different journeys; each lesson counts once when you complete it.
howTo.roadmap_finisher: In one journey, complete every lesson in every phase — stay on the same roadmap until nothing is left to finish.
howTo.achievement_fan: Keep completing lessons and reaching milestones. This badge appears automatically once you hold any five achievements (including skill and topic tiers).
howTo.topic_explorer: Complete lessons whose categories span at least three different topic areas. Tags on each lesson line up with the topic buckets used in analytics.

clusterMilestone.once: Complete one lesson whose category is “{cluster}” (each lesson shows a topic tag; analytics use the same buckets). Only lessons on active journeys count.
clusterMilestone.twice: Complete two lessons categorized as “{cluster}” across your active journeys.
clusterMilestone.many: Complete three or more lessons categorized as “{cluster}” across your active journeys.

skillMilestone.once: Complete one lesson that lists “{skill}” in its skill tags on the roadmap or lesson page. Those tags match what you actually practice in that lesson.
skillMilestone.many: Complete three or more lessons tagged with “{skill}”.
